detail.reason:
Taught checkpoint archaeology (sync bisect, query --checkpoint, sync diff) to read set-v2 checkpoints -- the layout every fresh workspace has published by default since 5d4c08a6.

Product gap closed: src/service/archaeology.rs bailed with `bead: Internal error: Verified checkpoint has unsupported mode 'set-v2'` after the shared verifier had already passed, because it re-materialized records with a private monolith/sharded-only reader. Change (commit 748bcfea, pushed to origin/main; HEAD == origin/main verified at close):
- load_verified_view consumes the ForensicStaging that verify_restore_source already produces for monolithic, sharded, and set-v2 through new read-only accessors on VerifiedRestoreSource (fields stay private, so no caller can mint a verified source); the duplicated per-layout readers were deleted. Every layout that restores also queries (checkpoint-set-v2.md section 10).
- resolve_artifact accepts pointer-selected set/*.json manifests alongside manifests/*.json and objects/*.jsonl.
- tests/r029_checkpoint_archaeology.rs: monolith fixture pinned explicitly; retained-generation tests query an immutable frozen first-generation copy (the committed-generation shape archaeology consumes); the pointer-selected-manifest test moved from the no-longer-selectable sharded writer to the set-v2 manifest; new regression test set_v2_pointer_bisect_queries_the_default_workspace_layout encodes this bead's reproduction.
- README names the set-v2 manifest among accepted archaeology artifacts.

Observable completion: the reproduction command now succeeds and reports the matching generation (mode "set-v2") instead of exiting 1; the exposing sweep test passes; 6/6 r029 archaeology conformance tests pass.

Scope notes: repo-wide `cargo fmt --check` exit 0 at 748bcfea. Repo-wide clippy is red on the shared working tree solely from uncommitted rival WIP (src/service/git.rs:82, double_ended_iterator_last); with that one lint allowed, clippy -D warnings is green on the lib and the r029 target. Separately discovered, pre-existing on main and NOT fixed here (documented on beadrs-e8b8986c, whose section 12 scenario 1 acceptance covers it): a retained set-v2 generation whose open tail has since grown fails verify_restore_source, so `bead restore --generation <previous.json's gen>` exits 5 ("tail set/tail.jsonl unusable"); archaeology against a live workspace's previous.json meets the same shared-verifier refusal, which is why the retained-generation tests use frozen snapshots. Also pre-existing on main and out of scope: every_mutating_command_advances_the_live_event_sequence (import-only fixture expects forensic.jsonl, retired under set-v2) and every_leaf_command_is_classified (unclassified `bead sync resolve`, rival WIP surface).


Declared bead sync resolve's event contract: Mutating — restoring the incoming side of a conflicted pull merges the pulled events into the live store and appends the merge machinery's summary event (the sync reconcile precedent; no separate append was missing).

Registry entry (tests/mutating_command_event_contract.rs) drives a real conflicted index in the sweep: sync configure --mode monolithic pins the layout resolve's verifier accepts and publishes the local generation, a wholesale clone (shared store UUID, R028) advances one issue and auto-publishes the covering generation, git update-index --index-info registers stage 2 (local flush) and stage 3 (incoming), and the worktree pointer carries marker text.

Declaring the contract forced two fatal bugs in the shipped command into the open, both fixed in d392e3d0:
1. verified_candidates matched checkpoint-relative names (current.json) against git ls-files output, which is repository-root-relative (.beads/checkpoint/current.json): no candidate could ever verify, so every conflicted workspace was refused with "neither conflicted side verifies". Fix: strip the CHECKPOINT_PATHSPEC prefix when assembling the candidate fileset.
2. resolve_conflicts holds the checkpoint publication lock across the recovery, then both merge arms re-acquired it on a second file description (reconcile_checkpoint; import_conflict_branch via acquire_store_checkpoint_publication_lock) and self-deadlocked into the 30s lock timeout ("checkpoint publication lock busy"). Fix: reconcile_checkpoint gains the lock-holding half the other recovery entries use (reconcile_checkpoint_holding), and import_conflict_branch now takes the caller's lock.

Verification, clean git-archive extraction of d392e3d0 (/data/build/bead-rs/gate-a7e7afac-20261025-222158, private target /data/build/bead-rs/gate-a7e7afac-target, TMPDIR chain probed .beads/.git-free):

- every_mutating_command_advances_the_live_event_sequence: red on a PRE-EXISTING foreign leg — "bead sync import-only" reads a forensic.jsonl the set-v2 default no longer writes (fixture construction this diff never touches; beadrs-a8019498's class, exact fix shape noted on that bead). With that single foreign-fixture line pinned monolithic as an uncommitted diagnostic in the extraction, the same test passes exit=0 and executes bead sync resolve in-suite (exit 0, live event sequence advanced); the pin is deliberately not absorbed here.
- scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast (BEAD_DOD_TMPBASE=/data/build/bead-rs): fails at attempt_summary_json, a foreign leg verbatim on beadrs-a8019498's list; cargo fmt --check passed inside it.
